reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit-risk signals with zero missingness and broad coverage. Key credit concepts such as borrower capacity (income, DTI, loan to income), credit quality (FICO mean and band), indebtedness and utilization (revolving utilization, balance to credit limits), delinquency proxies (recent inquiries), and customer history (number of trade lines, mortgage accounts) are well represented. Redundancy is controlled by preferring representative aggregates over near-duplicates, especially within FICO and utilization groups. Features with potential leakage or unstable operational proxies were excluded. The selection balances semantic coverage across repayment behavior, exposure, capacity, and customer profile, ensuring defensibility in scorecard reviews and stable out-of-time generalization.
